free_tier.stated: No storage quota published, because the product is not storage. The free Community edition is the self-hosted OSS runtime under Apache 2.0 with community-only support; the hosted Cloud tier is 'subscription and usage-based pricing with tiered plans'. The datasets it serves are 'free, ready-to-query sample datasets' hosted by Spice, not by you.

egress.terms: Usage-based on Cloud; unmetered only if you self-host and pay your own egress.

record.tooling: A SQL query endpoint over the Spice runtime, and a Data Connector model that federates to external sources. Self-hosting gives full control but on your own hardware.
record.chaining: None for capacity. The free tier is software, so the bytes land wherever you point it (S3, GCS, local). It is a query layer, and a useful one, but it multiplies nothing.
record.limits_note: fails-quota: no free hosted bytes at all. Per-app request rate limits exist on Cloud per the management API docs.
record.reliability_note: Service provides analytical data infrastructure and query endpoints rather than general raw object storage.
